_about: Names a document gives as an Organization or a Person that name something else: a building, a law, a course or a job title. The document model's statements are checked against these rules, and one naming such a thing as an Organization or a Person is rejected. Words are compared lower-cased, without surrounding punctuation. building_words and law_words end an Organization's name ('Boyd Hall', 'Clery Act'); they are not applied to people, since Hall and Law are also family names. law_patterns match a whole Organization name ('Title IX'). course_pattern matches the start of either name ('CS 101', 'BIO 210L Lab'). A Person's name is a job title when it ends with one of title_endings ('Chief Information Officer', 'Vice President'), or when one of title_words is followed by of or for ('Dean of Students', 'Director for Admissions'); Dean alone ('Dean Smith', 'John Dean') is a name.
